profile.name: Hissan Sethi
profile.title: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.introHighlight: I build modern, fast and scalable web applications with a focus on clean code, thoughtful UX and real-world solutions.
profile.bio: I am a Full Stack Web Developer and computer science student based in Peshawar, Pakistan. Dedicated to creating high-performance web applications, I combine solid architectural foundations with deliberate visual design to ship websites that feel fast, intuitive, and reliable.
profile.philosophy: Code should be readable, interfaces should be effortless, and every layout decision must serve the user. I avoid bloated templates and focus on building purposeful, production-grade web solutions.

projects.title: HS Cloud
projects.subtitle: Cloud Storage & File Management
projects.description: A modern cloud file management and storage workspace with intuitive asset filtering, real-time activity views, and responsive storage telemetry.
projects.longDescription: HS Cloud is engineered to provide a frictionless file storage and asset tracking interface. Built with an emphasis on speed and spatial clarity, it organizes user drives, media files, and document archives into a structured, responsive workspace.
features: Clean directory hierarchy and instant file search
Storage metric visualization and category breakdowns
Multi-format file preview modal and quick metadata inspection
Fully responsive workspace optimized for mobile and desktop screens

projects.title: HS Restaurant
projects.subtitle: Restaurant Website
projects.description: A responsive dining website featuring interactive culinary menus, chef signature highlights, and an online table reservation inquiry system.
projects.longDescription: HS Restaurant provides an atmospheric dining web presence for an upscale eatery. Visitors can browse multi-course menus categorized by appetisers, signature mains, and chef specials, complete with an intuitive online table booking workflow.
features: Interactive dietary filter for breakfast, lunch and dinner menus
Visual booking form with timestamp validation
Chef spotlight showcase and customer reviews
Fluid responsive layout tested on all screen sizes

projects.title: HS Fragrance
projects.subtitle: Fragrance Store
projects.description: An e-commerce product showcase for luxury perfumes with scent profile filtering, bottle size options, and an interactive shopping cart preview.
projects.longDescription: HS Fragrance is designed to deliver a sensory shopping journey for luxury perfumes and artisanal colognes. Users can filter by olfactory families, explore top/heart/base fragrance pyramids, and review bottle variations.
features: Scent note pyramid breakdown (Top, Heart, Base)
Dynamic volume selector with price adjustment
Interactive shopping cart with item persistence
Mobile-first checkout simulation layout

projects.title: Sethi Tech Store
projects.subtitle: Electronics E-Commerce
projects.description: A gadget shopping hub with product specifications, dynamic price calculation, category filtering, and quick cart management.
projects.longDescription: Sethi Tech Store is an electronics e-commerce storefront offering desktop computers, mobile devices, audio gear, and peripheral accessories. Built with category filters, dynamic inventory badges, and live search.
features: Comprehensive category filtering (Audio, Computing, Accessories)
Real-time search query filtering and stock status
Detailed modal for technical specs and connectivity options
Cart drawer with live order subtotal calculation

projects.title: HS Calc App
projects.subtitle: Interactive Calculator Web App
projects.description: A scientific web calculator with memory functions, expression history logs, and instant keyboard event handling.
projects.longDescription: HS Calc App provides precision computation inside an uncluttered interface. Supporting standard arithmetic, scientific modifiers, equation memory tracking, and dark-mode themes.
features: Memory store, recall, and clear operations
Full keyboard entry mapping with visual keystroke feedback
Interactive calculation history tape with result re-use
Zero-dependency vanilla JavaScript engine
